rationale_1_monte_carlo_measurement_nois.description: Finite-sample evaluation uncertainty of a SINGLE fixed run at M=1,000 sequences (1.96 * SE_bootstrap of GPT-2 Large token-weighted Gen-PPL across 48 non-collapsed ELF-B runs).

rationale_2_within_cell_cross_seed_repea.description: Pooled within-cell cross-seed standard deviation sigma_seed across independent RNG seeds of the EXACT SAME configuration (df_B=50 on ELF-B, df_M=18 on ELF-M), and the 95% Bland-Altman repeatability limit (2.77 * sigma_seed) between two independent seeds of the same sampler.

Tier_I_Strict_Repeatability.justification: Matches the two-sample Monte Carlo 95% evaluation noise bound (2.0% * sqrt(2) = 2.8%) and ~3x pure cross-seed SD of H_ps (0.0049 nats).

Tier_II_Moderate_Practical.justification: Corresponds to 5% relative Gen-PPL (~0.05 nats NLL, <1/3 of the 16-17.5% frontier shift from ELF-B to ELF-M) and 0.025 nats (<0.5% of H_ps).

Family_4_Contextual_and_Semantic_Alignme: mauve (GPT-2 Large contextual states vs OWT)
semantic_embedding_diversity (T5 / GPT-2 / MPNet cosine & Vendi score)

nfe_accounting_formula.why_logged_nfe_elf_exceeds_K_plus_1: In elfx/sample.py L180-184, decode_latents chunks a batch of size B into slices of 32 to bound fp32 (chunk, L, vocab) memory, incrementing CounterWrapper ceil(B/32) times per batch. Thus logged nfe_elf = K + ceil(B/32) (e.g. 32 + 8 = 40 at B=256; 32 + 4 = 36 at B=128; 64 + 2 = 66 at B=48).
nfe_accounting_formula.why_sc_cfg_has_zero_extra_forward_passes: In ELF/src/utils/sampling_utils.py L152-161, config.num_self_cond_cfg_tokens == 4 > 0 (guidance-distilled conditioning tokens). Every step concatenates [z, x_pred_prev] along dim=-1 and passes self_cond_cfg_scale as a conditioning scalar in ONE forward pass for all s in [1.0, 4.0].
nfe_accounting_formula.sde_vs_ode_extra_ops: In elfx/sample.py L142-164, SDE steps (gamma > 0) draw one Gaussian tensor eps ~ N(0, I) of shape (B, L, D) and perform two elementwise linear combinations (alpha * z + (1 - alpha) * eps). This adds O(B*L*D) RNG/vector ops (<0.2% of transformer FLOPs) and 0 extra neural forward passes.
